jobs_results.description:
Introduction

A career in IBM Consulting is built on long-term client relationships and close collaboration worldwide. You'll work with leading companies across industries, helping them shape their hybrid cloud and AI journeys. With support from our strategic partners, robust IBM technology, and Red Hat, you'll have the tools to drive meaningful change and accelerate client impact. At IBM Consulting, curiosity fuels success. You'll be encouraged to challenge the norm, explore new ideas, and create innovative solutions that deliver real results. Our culture of growth and empathy focuses on your long-term career development while valuing your unique skills and experiences.

Your Role And Responsibilities

As a Business Transformation Consultant specializing in Data Platforms, you will plan, design, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms, as well as other similar non-IBM solutions. This role involves creating solutions that deliver significant and lasting business improvements for clients.

Your Primary Responsibilities Will Include

 Design Solution Architecture: Provide expert architecture, design, and implementation support for solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions. Implement Data Platforms: Plan, manage, and implement core components of Watson Service Offerings and Digital Insights Platforms to deliver significant business improvements for clients. Support Sales and Delivery: Define solutions and present a point of view for these offerings' services to clients, collaborating with Sales and Delivery teams. Develop Cloud-Based Solutions: Create solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, leveraging expertise in architecture, data lake, design, and implementation. Drive Business Transformation: Deliver lasting business improvements for clients through the implementation of Data Platforms and Watson Service Offerings.This job can be performed from anywhere in the US.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree

Required Technical And Professional Expertise

 Deep Expertise in Data Platforms: Proven experience in planning, designing, managing, and implementing core components of data platforms, Snowflake, Databricks and Digital Insights Platforms, to deliver significant business improvements for clients. Experience with Cloud-Based Solutions: Skilled in creating solutions in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions, leveraging expertise in architecture, data lake, design, and implementation. Proficiency in Solution Architecture: Experienced in providing expert architecture, design, and implementation support for solutions in complex environments, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery. Experience in Implementation and Integration: Proven ability to plan, manage, and implement core components of data platforms, ensuring successful integration with existing systems and infrastructure. Strong Understanding of Business Transformation: Experienced in delivering lasting business improvements for clients through the implementation of data platforms and Watson Service Offerings, driving business transformation and growth.

Preferred Technical And Professional Experience

 Data Lake Expertise: Deep understanding of data lake architecture and design, with experience in implementing data lakes in virtualized and cloud-based environments, including both hosted and on-premise solutions. Virtualization Knowledge: Familiarity with virtualization technologies and their application in data platform solutions, ensuring seamless integration and effective solution delivery. job_highlights.title: Responsibilities
items: The Data Architect is responsible for designing, developing, and governing the enterprise data architecture that enables reliable, secure, scalable, and accessible data across the organization

This role establishes the frameworks, standards, models, and integration patterns that define how data is collected, structured, stored, integrated, governed, and consumed across business applications and analytics platforms
The Data Architect serves as a strategic and technical partner to business leaders, IT, application teams, data and analytics teams, and external partners
The role is particularly important in an environment with multiple business units, brands, locations, ERP platforms, and acquired or integrated businesses

The successful candidate will balance long-term enterprise architecture with practical business needs, helping the organization improve data quality, simplify its technology landscape, strengthen governance, and establish a trusted foundation for reporting, analytics, automation, and artificial intelligence
Develop and maintain the enterprise data architecture strategy, standards, principles, and roadmaps aligned with business and technology objectives
Design scalable data architectures across cloud, on-premise, and hybrid environments supporting structured and unstructured data
Define current and future-state architectures, reduce complexity and technical debt, and establish patterns for data ingestion, storage, integration, transformation, consumption, and retention
Evaluate emerging technologies and ensure architecture decisions enable future capabilities in analytics, AI, machine learning, and automation
Data Modeling & Design
Develop and govern conceptual, logical, and physical data models supporting enterprise applications, reporting, analytics, and integrations
Establish enterprise data standards, definitions, canonical models, metadata, lineage, retention, and lifecycle management practices
Partner with business and technical teams to identify authoritative data sources and ensure models support both operational and analytical needs
ERP & Enterprise Systems Integration
Provide architecture leadership for SAP S/4HANA and other enterprise platforms, including finance, HR, CRM, manufacturing, supply chain, and e-commerce systems
Define integration standards and data exchange frameworks across applications, acquired businesses, legacy systems, and external partners
Support implementations, migrations, conversions, and transformation initiatives while ensuring cross-functional business processes are effectively integrated
Data Governance & Quality
Define data ownership, stewardship, and accountability while implementing controls that ensure data quality, consistency, accuracy, completeness, and timeliness
Develop processes to identify and resolve systemic data issues and maintain enterprise metadata, lineage, data catalogs, and business glossaries
Data Integration & Analytics Enablement
Define architecture standards for APIs, data pipelines, ETL/ELT processes, warehouses, lakes, and analytics platforms
Collaborate with reporting and analytics teams to ensure data is structured, governed, and accessible for enterprise reporting and self-service analytics
Promote reusable integration patterns and reduce redundant data repositories and point-to-point integrations
AI & Advanced Analytics Readiness
Establish data architecture requirements that support AI, machine learning, predictive analytics, and generative AI initiatives
Assess data readiness for business use cases and ensure AI solutions leverage secure, governed, accurate, and traceable enterprise data from multiple sources
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business recommendations, risks, and opportunities
Facilitate architecture governance, standards reviews, and decision-making processes across business and technology teams
Partner with project teams throughout solution delivery and guide stakeholders toward decisions that support long-term enterprise data strategy
Influence & Collaboration: Builds alignment across technical and non-technical stakeholders and effectively challenges decisions that introduce unnecessary complexity or risk
Problem Solving: Diagnoses complex data problems, identifies root causes, evaluates alternatives, and recommends sustainable solutions
Communication: Communicates technical concepts clearly to executives, business leaders, project teams, and technical professionals
Execution: Converts architecture strategy into practical standards, designs, roadmaps, and implementation requirements

jobs_results.description:
Job#: 3057452

Job Description:

Enterprise Data Architect

Location: Remote

Role Overview

An established organization is seeking a skilled Enterprise Data Architect to translate desired business capabilities into robust solution concepts, technology patterns, and service structures. The selected professional will guide information management and governance processes while evaluating integration opportunities across the enterprise. This position requires a strategic thinker who can deliver architectural artifacts across business, information, data, and technology domains to support critical investment decisions.

Key Responsibilities

Translate business capabilities into well-defined projects with clear objectives and deliverables.Visualize and communicate architecture concepts, principles, and models for enterprise programs and domains.Facilitate architecture discussions with cross-functional business sponsors to ensure alignment.Set direction and approve future-state architecture standards, guidelines, blueprints, and roadmaps.Drive architecture-related research to mature standards and direct innovation prototypes.Deliver comprehensive architecture artifacts, including business, information, data, process, and technology architectures.Promote the business value of information integration and architecture management to senior leadership.Provide guidance on strategy, planning, prioritization, and portfolio management.

Required Qualifications

Education: Bachelor's Degree or completion of a relevant Certification Program.

Experience: At least 10 years of experience in Information Technology, with a minimum of 5 years focused on Information/Data Architecture, Data Engineering, or advanced Database Design and Modeling. This must include hands-on experience implementing OLTP/RDBMS databases, Data Warehouses, and Data Marts. Additionally, 4 or more years of experience using data modeling tools such as Power Designer is required, alongside experience utilizing Google Cloud Platform (GCP) technologies including BigQuery, AlloyDB, PostgreSQL, Cloud Run, MongoDB, and Data Flow.

Technical Skills: Proficiency in Data Architecture, Data Analysis, Data Integrity, Data Governance, Data Modeling, Data Warehousing, Database Management, and Master Data Management (MDM) concepts.

Preferred Qualifications

Familiarity with Enterprise Architecture standards and frameworks such as TOGAF or DAMA.Experience with one or more PLM platforms, such as Siemens’ Teamcenter or Dassault’s 3D Experience.Knowledge of .NET Core and interoperability standards.Proven leadership skills with the ability to self-manage, resolve ambiguity, and build consensus among stakeholders.

Managing professional employees or supervising team members to deliver complex technical initiatives, you will apply your depth of expertise to guide others and interpret internal/external issues to recommend quality solutions. As Data Architect – Senior Manager, you will have an expert understanding of data architecture and data engineering and will be focused on problem-solving to design, architect, and present findings and solutions, leading more junior team members, and working with a wide variety of clients to sell and lead delivery of technology consulting services. You are responsible for helping to win new business for EY. You are a trusted advisor with a broad understanding of digital transformation initiatives, the analytic technology landscape, industry trends and client motivations. You are also a charismatic communicator and thought leader, capable of going toe-to-toe with the C-level in our clients and prospects and willing and able to constructively challenge them.

jobs_results.description:
Standard Job Description

Join Lockheed Martin's Data & AI Enablement organization and accelerate the company's AI transformation. As a lead data architect, you will drive the creation of logical data models that underpin our next‑generation data products and enterprise ontology. You will partner with Data Product Owners by architecting data models, data pipelines and ontologies, and ensure consistent semantic definitions across the Enterprise Data Ecosystem (EDE). The role operates in a Databricks‑centric environment, integrating source systems such as SAP and Apriso upstream, and powering AI agents and analytics applications downstream. By governing and expanding the semantic layer of the corporate data foundation, you will play a key role in the company's AI transformation.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with Data Product Owners to capture business requirements and create robust logical data models.Design federated ontologies and knowledge‑graph structures that enrich data products and support AI agents, AI reasoning, and analytics applications.Ensure models deliver clean, well‑documented feature sets for machine‑learning pipelines; work with data scientists to embed model‑ready attributes (feature stores, lineage metadata).Define logical representations for SAP, Apriso, and other source systems and guide ingestion patterns that preserve semantic integrity.Produce architecture artifacts (diagrams, data dictionaries, ontology catalogs) and enforce data‑quality, security, and lineage standards.Design data entities in a way so that they can be productized to ensure they meet the requirements of their documented use cases.Collaborate with the Lead Data Engineer to validate designs.Continuously improve modeling processes, promote ontology reuse, and stay current on semantic‑modeling and Databricks advancements.Advise on the technology stack used in team operations.Basic Qualifications

Bachelor's (or higher) in Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Information Management, or a related field.10 + years of large-scale data architecture/engineering experience, with at least 5 years focused on productizing data assets for enterprise consumption.Significant experience designing/operationalizing ontologies.Demonstrated ability to probe for and understand core customer needs as opposed to surface-level needs.Strong programming skills in Python and SQL; proficient with Spark (PySpark/Scala) and deep experience with AI-assisted development.Experience with data‑integration/orchestration tools (e.g., NiFi, Airflow) for pipeline development.Must be a US Citizen.Desired Skills

Experience with Databricks (Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, Jobs/Workflows).Experience with federated data models and ontologies.Excellent interpersonal and collaboration skills for cross‑functional teamwork and internal‑customer support.Master's degree or advanced technical training (optional).Databricks certifications (Data Engineer Associate/Professional) or comparable big‑data credentials.Experience developing applications leveraging genAI.Pay Information
